description: This is a Java source file implementing the data access object (DAO) for Manufacturer entities, providing methods to count products linked to a manufacturer, retrieve manufacturers by store and language, get manufacturer by ID, and list manufacturers associated with specific categories.

classes.name: ManufacturerDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for Manufacturer, extending base DAO class and implementing manufacturer-specific queries.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Counts the number of products associated with a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a manufacturer by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers for a specific store.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products in specified categories within a store and language.
